digest.component_or_area: code-review verdict assembly and sidecar signing
propositions: Code-review verdicts never set provider_provenance despite the sidecar reading for it, leaving signed verdicts unable to attribute which provider/endpoint/tier produced them
The code_review_coach and finalize_code_review_verdict paths assemble terminal verdicts with only model and runner fields, omitting the provenance record that the Pass-2 verify step already computed
The provider_provenance must be threaded from the verify agent step's output through workflow_ops and finalize to the verdict, not recomputed at verdict assembly time
The degraded/outage verdict path must omit provider_provenance rather than synthesizing it from config when no model ran
Existing tests pass despite the missing field because they hand-build verdicts pre-populated with provider_provenance, never exercising the real assembly path
